_note: Counts prefixed n_runs_ are Saltelli rows (one qoi.csv line each; in sampled mode several rows share one solve); counts prefixed n_blocks_ are Saltelli blocks of block_size rows. A block is dropped from a QoI's Sobol' analysis when any of its rows is failed or non-finite for that QoI. A Dice is NaN when the model and the reference masks are both empty, a log_vol_ratio when the reference is empty, msd / hd95 when either mask is empty, the mass-weighted field QoIs when the field's mass is at or below the mass floor.
